group_definition.sensitivity: repeat at abs_rho>=0.5 and report community-level agreement

evaluation_unit: permute all columns in one correlated group jointly within a fixed validation fold
why_preferred: 227 chemical features contain strongly correlated communities
single-feature permutation can split credit arbitrarily among correlated proxies
the existing graph supplies auditable groups without fitting a new conditional density model
conditional_shap_reason: n=175 training samples is small relative to 227 features; no validated conditional sampler or cross-fitted conditional SHAP implementation is present. Running it now would add modeling risk and could be mistaken for confirmatory evidence.
causal_scope: Both methods assess predictive attribution under correlation; neither identifies causality.
